description: Get the most recent commands sent to a device (asset) in the authenticated company, newest first: type, status, timestamps, a short outcome code and who sent it. requestedByType USER means a portal user, named in requestedBy by email (also when Nomid Agent sent it for them; SUPPORT is Nomid or partner support); API_KEY means an integration, named by the key's name. No requestedBy means no person or key was recorded: Nomid itself (a policy change, an automation), the device, or a command sent before this was recorded; never guess who it was. When Google said why a command failed, reason carries it: RESET_PASSWORD_RECENTLY means lost mode was refused because the device's password was reset shortly before (Android blocks lost mode for a while after a reset; try again later without resetting it again), USER_EXIT_LOST_MODE_RECENTLY that the user recently left lost mode, ALREADY_IN_LOST_MODE / NOT_IN_LOST_MODE that the device was already in / not in lost mode. Command payloads and any sensitive data (e.g. passwords) are never included. Returns a tool error if no asset with that id exists in this company.

assetId.description: The asset's path name - the unique identifier returned by search_devices/get_device as "pathName".

company.description: Optional: a `company` value from list_companies to run this in. Omit it for the connection's own company.

limit.description: Maximum number of commands to return, newest first. Defaults to 20, capped at 50.

name: list_device_commands
title: List device commands
